backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, access control, API credential storage, and stubbed payment orchestration with transaction listing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with PWA manifest, icons, fonts, metadata, and script mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and startup behavior.
frontend/public/sw.js: Basic service worker implementing caching for offline support and PWA installability.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app managing authentication, role-based views, profile setup, and PWA service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer for authenticated views.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Header with logo, navigation, PWA install button, and authenticated user menu supporting admin views.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Renders a logo image with size variants and falls back to a styled text wordmark if loading fails.
frontend/src/components/PwaInstallButton: Shows an install button when a PWA install prompt is available and triggers installation on click.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminCredent: Form for entering and securely saving ContiPay API credentials using a mutation with success and error states.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminTransac: Fetches and displays all processed transactions with status badges, error handling, and loading states.
frontend/src/features/auth/LoginScreen.t: Login page using Internet Identity with loading/error UI, app branding, and optional PWA install button.
frontend/src/features/auth/ProfileSetupM: Modal prompting the user to enter their name and saving the profile via a mutation with validation and feedback.
frontend/src/features/payments/PaymentRe: Displays payment success, pending, or failure with transaction details and an option to start over.
frontend/src/features/payments/PaymentWi: Multi-step wizard collecting card and EcoCash info, confirming details, and showing payment results.
frontend/src/features/payments/usePaymen: Hook managing payment initiation through the actor, tracking result state and exposing reset and mutation status.
frontend/src/features/payments/validatio: Provides basic validation functions for card details, EcoCash numbers, and amounts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context with login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstallPrompt.t: Exposes PWA installability state and a method to trigger the install prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches the caller’s user profile via the actor, handling loading and fetch state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, query client provider, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker on page load if supported.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with themes, colors, fonts, plugins, and content paths.
project_state.json: Contains project state metadata, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features for the 7 Bucks payment app.
